calendarNote: 90-day calendar started 2026-10-06. Days 1-30: one app module a day. Days 31-60: guides (80G/12A, CSR-1, FCRA, registration). Days 61-90: how-to and recaps. Short at 12:30 PM IST, lesson at 6:30 PM IST.

days.hook: Social sector jobs and internships in one place
points: Open Opportunities on impact-connect.in
Filter by Type: job, internship, fellowship and more
Apply only through the official source after checking its rules
lines_hi: social sector की jobs और internships एक ही जगह देखिए
impact-connect.in पर Opportunities खोलिए

हर listing का source और review date दिखता है
apply हमेशा official source से, नियम जाँचकर कीजिए

reviewed.note: Live app: Opportunities lists jobs, internships, fellowships, contracts and freelance projects from official sources with a Type filter first. Site's own words: it verifies the published source and review date but is not the employer and does not guarantee role, selection or salary; apply only through the official source after checking current rules. Script mirrors this and claims nothing more.

days.hook: Free courses for nonprofit skills
points: Open Learn on impact-connect.in

reviewed.note: Live app: Learn lists resources with provider, type, access and cause fields, marked Official source reviewed; includes free The Open University OpenLearn courses (access: Free), e.g. Introducing the voluntary sector and leadership practice. Script only claims free courses exist and to start from the official provider page.

days.hook: Choose a cause, volunteer your way
points: Open Volunteering on impact-connect.in

lines_hi: अपनी पसंद की cause चुनकर volunteer कीजिए

reviewed.note: Live app: Volunteering lists opportunities with organisation, state/district, SDG cause filter and official source links with verified dates. Consent flow copy: volunteer re-confirms which private fields may be shared; approved details are shared privately. Script mirrors this consent model without promising placements.
